turnover_spikes.title: Turnover spikes

verify_ref.note: The flagged day on the daily volume series.

notes: A day is flagged above median + 5x MAD of the operating period in its own currency. MAD is unscaled — the multiplier is an operating dial, not a normality argument.

The baseline covers only the dense operating period. The export is effectively a June book (4 betslips in March, 11 in April, 117 in May, 77,300 in June), so ~23 real trading days is too little history for a seasonal or trailing baseline.
Low confidence by construction. A deployment with months of history would use a seasonal baseline; this is the honest version of the detector given what the export contains.

abnormal_exposure.title: Abnormal exposure

verify_ref.note: The fixture's overall volume, for comparison against the share this one selection carries.

notes: Fixtures at or above the 90% turnover percentile with at least 50 legs, where one selection holds 50%+ of the fixture.
`single_actor` marks a share driven by one Uid window — individual behaviour, not market-wide exposure.
Turnover shown at leg grain: valid for comparison within this breakdown only. A combined betslip repeats its stake on every leg, so the leg-grain total runs 1.07x above the true betslip-grain figure.
